# David Hou

> I'm a builder and operator working at the intersection of education and AI. I believe AI will change the way we learn, and I'm passionate about building the best interface for that shift.

## About

I'm currently a product lead at Decagon (https://decagon.ai), working on our education and internal AI initiatives. I work on learning products and experiences that bring product enablement into the platform, as well as Arc, our internal AI workspace and company brain. I'm also involved in the entire learning journey for our product: from ops and docs to the AI automations that power our content to leading live trainings and workshops for our biggest and most strategic accounts.

Previously, I was at MongoDB, where I led documentation and developer experience for our AI products, including Voyage AI, Vector Search, and the MongoDB MCP Server. I also served as my team's AI technologist: evaluating new AI tooling, building workflows that made our team more productive, and creating a culture of innovative yet responsible AI use. Before that, I did technical and UX writing at New Relic. In college, I was Co-Editor-in-Chief of the Yale Record, America's oldest humor magazine.

I live in NYC.

## 0 to 1 Product Initiatives (Decagon)

### Arc
- Arc in Slack: Puts the company brain where every team already works. Ask questions across company knowledge, take action in your connected tools, and keep sensitive results private.
- Arc Search & Retrieval: Makes institutional knowledge findable across teams, so people get grounded answers instead of digging through Slack, docs, and Notion.
- Compass: An agentic LMS that ramps all of Decagon's internal teams. In development.

### Decagon University
- AI Tutor: A multimodal voice agent that runs product education live, using the browser to walk customers through the platform and answer questions in real time.
- Labs: Hands-on labs where customers complete real workflows with Duet inside the product, instead of practicing in a sandbox.
- Curricula: Decagon's flagship customer learning program, from Fundamentals to Deep Dives, built to make customer teams confident building on the platform.

### Internal AI tools
- Claude Tag: Brought Claude into the customer team's daily workflow in partnership with Anthropic: instant answers, bug triage, and request intake across team channels.
- Self-healing docs agent: Docs that keep pace with the product. 95% of doc updates are now automated, 200% more PRs are merged per month, and 10+ teams across the company have adopted it.
- Self-healing slides: A single source of truth for enablement decks that stays accurate as the product ships, so field teams always present current material.

## Personal Projects

- [Prompt Saver MCP Server](https://github.com/davidhou17/prompt-saver-mcp): Saves successful LLM conversation threads as reusable prompts for future tasks.
- [Local Docs Evals](https://github.com/davidhou17/local-docs-eval): A fully local evaluation suite for documentation repositories.
- [MongoDB Education MCP Server](https://github.com/mongodb/chatbot/tree/prompt_maxxing/packages/mcp): Finalist in MongoDB's company hackathon (top 8% of submissions).
- [LangGraph MongoDB Movie Agent](https://github.com/davidhou17/langgraph-mongodb-movie-agent): A conversational agent using MongoDB for agentic RAG and short- and long-term memory.

## DevEx Content (MongoDB)

- [Jupyter Notebooks for AI Developers](https://github.com/mongodb/docs-notebooks): Collection of Jupyter notebooks for AI development.
- [Natural Language to MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/natural-language-to-mongodb/): Guide to using LLMs to convert natural language into MongoDB queries.
- [Build AI Agents with MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-vector-search/ai-agents/): Foundational guide to building AI agents with MongoDB.
- [MongoDB MCP Server](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/): Docs for the MongoDB MCP Server.
- [Voyage AI by MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai): Docs for Voyage AI's embedding and reranking models.
- [MongoDB Vector Search](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-vector-search/vector-search-overview/): Docs for MongoDB Vector Search.
- [AI Framework and Platform Integrations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/ai-integrations/): Docs for MongoDB's AI integrations.
